headline: Voted to have FordHarrison present MOU to City of Bristol; ended Mangines & Burke engagement; tabled Shipman & Goodwin contract.
summary: Approved bills paid in July 2026 and tabled a per diem nurse legal fees question until September. Ended the Mangines & Burke legal engagement, tabled a new Shipman & Goodwin engagement, and closed a Thomaston Savings Bank account. Members were also appointed to the Personnel, Finance, and Dental committees.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 9, 2026 meeting. All members voted in favor.
Approved the bills paid in July 2026. All members voted in favor.
Tabled the Per Diem Nurse legal fees question until the September meeting. All members voted in favor.
Approved the monthly reports. All members voted in favor.
Appointed Donna Friday, Doug Thompson, and Thomas O'Brien to the Personnel Committee, with Thomas O'Brien as chairman. All members voted in favor.
Appointed Thomas O'Brien and Doug Thompson to the Finance Committee, with Donna Friday remaining as chairwoman. All members voted in favor.
Appointed Jeffrey Beauchamp to the Dental Committee. All members voted in favor.
Tabled the new engagement of the law firm Shipman & Goodwin. All members voted in favor.
Approved ending the engagement with the law firm Mangines & Burke. Atty. Burke has thirty days to provide invoices for payment. All members voted in favor.
Approved having FordHarrison present the memorandum of understanding to the City of Bristol. All members voted in favor.
Approved closing the Thomaston Savings Bank account. All members voted in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais to approve the Board of Health Meeting Minutes of July 9, 2026. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais to approve the July, 2026 Bills. ... All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp, seconded by Member Donna Friday to table the Per Diem Nurse legal fees question until the September meeting. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to approve the monthly reports. ... All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Member Thomas O'Brien, seconded by Member Doug Thompson to appoint Member Donna Friday, Member Doug Thompson, Member Thomas O'Brien to the Personnel Committee with Member Thomas O'Brien as the Committee Chairman. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Member Thomas O'Brien, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to appoint Members Thomas O'Brien and Doug Thompson to the Finance Committee, with Committee Chairwoman Donna Friday remaining. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Thomas O'Brien, seconded by Member Doug Thompson to appoint Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to the Dental Committee. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Chairman Suchinski, seconded by Member Donna Friday to table the new engagement of Shipman & Goodwin in which the Chairman would sign an engagement. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Chairman Suchinski, seconded by Member Donna Friday to no longer engage with the law firm Mangines & Burke. Director Palmeri will give Atty. Burke thirty (30) days to provide any invoices to BBHD for payment. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Chairman Suchinski, seconded by Member Donna Friday to have FordHarrison present the MOU to the City of Bristol. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Chairman Suchinski, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to close the Thomaston Savings Bank account. All in Favor. Motion carried.
